rules: Built from a real viewer comment logged in content-os/community/replies-log.md or ideas.md. Respectful pain or question comments only: never a crisis comment (self-harm, suicide, abuse: those get the helpline reply, not a video), never a critique, AI accusation, song-name ask or bait. The comment text is shown on screen with the handle hidden (comment_reply.show_handle false). Same gates as every episode (R1-R13). Posted as a normal Reel/Short: Instagram's native 'reply with Reel' is not available through the Buffer API.

backlog.comment: I forgave her but I can't let her back in, and it left me hollow
backlog.r10_context: Romans 12:17-21: do not repay evil for evil; if it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men; leave vengeance to God. The 'if it be possible' and 'as much as lieth in you' admit that peace has limits on our side. Used for: forgiving (not paying back) does not oblige her to hand back full trust at once. Not used to tell her to cut the person off or to reconcile against wisdom.
